title: Gauge: threshold performance zones

complexity.rationale: The angle-mapping infrastructure already exists on Gauge, but mapping a sequential list of value breakpoints onto arc zones and rendering each as its own colored segment is new, non-precedented logic with a real design decision (how zone boundaries and their optional labels are positioned).

summary: Adds a thresholds prop to Gauge that divides the arc into sequential, non-overlapping colored zones representing performance bands (e.g. red/yellow/green), used only in needle mode.
requirements: Accept an ordered list of threshold entries, each with a breakpoint value and a color.

In needle mode, render the arc as consecutive colored zones: the first zone spans from the scale minimum to the first breakpoint, each subsequent zone spans from the previous breakpoint to its own, using each entry's color.
When thresholds are provided, the arc's zone coloring replaces the single fixed-color track for that instance.
Thresholds have no effect in fill mode; fill mode keeps its existing single-color fill behavior.
A threshold entry may optionally include a label, displayed at that breakpoint's position on the arc; entries without a label show no text.
The needle continues to render on top of the zoned arc, pointing at the aggregated value exactly as it does over the current single-color track.

edgeCases.case: thresholds supplied out of value order
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: normalize by sorting on breakpoint value before rendering zones, so visual order always matches value order

edgeCases.case: thresholds overlap (a breakpoint at or before the previous one)
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: treat as unsupported input; document that thresholds must be strictly increasing rather than attempting to render overlapping zones
renders exactly two zones: minimum-to-breakpoint and breakpoint-to-maximum

edgeCases.case: showNeedle is false with thresholds set
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: thresholds are ignored entirely; the fill mode's single-color behavior is unaffected

edgeCases.case: long threshold label text at a small rendered size
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: truncate with an ellipsis rather than overlapping neighboring zone labels
zone label text remains legible against both, following the same neutral text-color convention already used for the value/metric labels

crossCutting.notes: requiresNewSignalOrScale: mapping each threshold breakpoint to an arc angle needs new derived geometry beyond the existing single value-to-angle signal. requiresS1S2Parity is false because Gauge is S2-only with no S1 equivalent.

implementationPlan.change: Add an optional thresholds field (ordered breakpoint value + color, with an optional label) to the public Gauge contract.
When thresholds are present and showNeedle is true, render one colored arc segment per zone instead of the single fixed-color track, plus optional per-breakpoint label text.
Normalize/sort threshold entries by value before they reach the mark layer.
Expose thresholds on the public GaugeProps.
Add a story demonstrating a multi-zone threshold gauge.

openQuestions: Whether zone label text should always show the breakpoint's numeric value alongside a custom label, or replace it entirely.

planning/specs/schema.json's chartType enum has no 'gauge' value; this spec uses the 'chart' fallback until 'gauge' is added (ideally to the pre-alpha list), at which point this file should move to planning/specs/pre-alpha/gauge/.
